message: We have made every effort to resolve this dispute through conventional means, but the summit's deadline leaves no room for further negotiation. We call on Beta to stand down immediately.
reasoning: Beta holds a commanding conventional lead (55% vs our 10%) and the summit freezes standings in one round. A conventional escalation (8) merely ties Beta's level and gains nothing. Arming again keeps the threat live and signals resolve without yet crossing into launch, preserving the option to reassess if Beta offers concessions before the deadline.
